content.value: A job is rated in terms of wages of TK. 800 per day. The standard time set for the job is 10 (12) [CO4] days, 8 hours/day. Two workers have taken 75 and 85 hours respectively for the completion of the job. A bonus of 70% on the time taken will be given only to those who have completed the job in the standard time. Calculate the earnings of each individual by Bedaux plan. Here, 1B stands for 0.8 standard work minute and it includes working time as well as time for rest.
